description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

New .github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml (renamed to nightly.yml when the old one retires in dlv2-70) at trunk tip with separate jobs and separate failure labels: t3:docker (postgres, clickhouse, trino from docker-integration.yml), t3:cloud (credentialed, optional), t3:perf (perf-smoke), t3:matrix (Python 3.11-3.14 x Linux/macOS/Windows from cross-platform-validation.yml), t3:browser (firefox/webkit explorer), t3:extension (duckdb-datasketches from extension-smoke.yml), t3:install (pypi-latest installability from release-canary.yml), t3:drift (weekly: corpus-drift, pricing-data drift, submission-validator drift, cross-surface baseline autodetect); plus quarantined tests and durations-file refresh. Each failing domain opens/updates one issue with its own label and owner. An open t3:* issue marked release-blocking blocks release.yml (dlv2-51). The nightly trunk-tip run replaces the re-run that the retired develop-post-merge workflow did; per-push checks on develop now run in trunk.yml.
